description: seed.restore is the second human door: it names one record (set + key) and re-applies it from the available content, writing through the engine and stamping the actor from the CONNECTION, never params (S43-extra T6, SD10). It is how a diverged or removed record is re-applied — the case seed-refused's todo points to — and the result is the same per-record outcome shape as apply (a second copy would be a second truth). It carries no actor and no confirmation: the daemon does not pretend a socket can prove a human is present (SD11).
